name: Souichirou-senpai Daisuki!
source: Souichirou Tamase is chased by a stalker. His stalker is his ex girlfriend Sayaka Kouyama. A classmate of Souichirou, Miki Aikawa, tells him that he has to talk with her and tell her that she should leave him alone.
translation: 玉濑宗一郎遭到跟踪，而跟踪者正是前女友香山沙耶香。宗一郎的同班同学相川美纪告诉他，必须与沙耶香当面谈清楚，叫她不要再来纠缠。
